title: Fondue – Spanish Style
description: Everyone loves a good night with friends over tapas, right? Add this Spanish-style fondue to your next tapas or paella party and go down as the greatest host in history. The mouthwatering acidity in a nice Spanish white wine plays beautifully off the spiced paprika. Serve this dish up in everyone’s favorite heat-holder, the Fondue Pot!
ingredients: Cured chorizo, sliced (for dipping) or nice smoked ham
A par-boiled vegetable, like cauliflower or broccoli
directions: In a small saucepan, sauté garlic gently for just under one minute in oil.
Add wine and bring to a simmer. Add cheese and stir until melted.
Add cornstarch and season with pinches of paprika and saffron, salt and pepper, to taste.
Transfer to a fondue pot to keep heating and add a splash of sherry just before serving.
